categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: upstream manufacturing and trading of phosphor copper balls used as raw materials for printed circuit boards (PCBs), midstream drilling subcontracting services, and downstream full-process PCB production and sales. These segments collectively support stable revenue and enable integrated supply chain services with efficient production processes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes LME-registered 99.99% electrolytic copper and continuous casting technology for phosphor copper ball production. PCB manufacturing involves advanced processes including drilling with capabilities down to 0.1mm, plating, multilayer lamination, and HDI (High-Density Interconnect) technology. The firm emphasizes flexible, small-batch, multi-variety production with rapid delivery, supported by quality management systems like ISO9001, IATF16949, and ISO14001.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large domestic PCB manufacturers and electronics companies requiring PCBs for consumer electronics, industrial computers, automotive components, medical, military, aerospace, and security applications. The company serves diversified end markets such as AI servers, low-earth orbit satellites, electric vehicles, and communication devices, with a focus on niche, high-mix, low-volume orders.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in New Taipei City and Taoyuan City. Sales are predominantly domestic (about 88.64% of revenue), with exports mainly to the Americas (9.72%), Asia, Oceania, and Europe, reflecting a global customer base but concentrated in Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple points in the PCB supply chain: upstream as a producer of phosphor copper balls (raw materials), midstream providing drilling subcontracting services, and downstream as a full-process PCB manufacturer. This vertical integration enables one-stop services and supply chain resource consolidation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include vertical integration of the PCB supply chain, focusing on high-value, high-density, fine-line, and multilayer PCB products. R&D efforts target HDI arbitrary layer interconnection, 32-layer PCB processes, high-frequency composite boards, and carrier board products. The company invests in smart machinery to improve production efficiency and quality, and pursues sustainable development with environmental management systems and climate risk mitigation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of phosphor copper balls, drilling subcontracting services, and full-process PCB products. The company emphasizes small-batch, multi-variety orders with rapid delivery, catering to customer-specific needs. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a niche PCB manufacturer specializing in small-volume, high-mix, rapid-turnaround production, differentiating from competitors focused on mass production. It competes in the Taiwanese PCB industry, which holds a 34% global market share, with competitors in China, Japan, and South Korea. The firm maintains stable profitability in its niche through flexible production and integrated services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal year 2024 (113th year), the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$918 million, a slight decrease of 1.05% from the previous year. It achieved a net profit of NT$8.7 million, reversing prior years' losses. The company has a solid financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio of 25.41% and continues to invest in capacity and technology upgrades. Market share within domestic listed PCB companies is about 0.12%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers unique value through its ability to produce small-batch, diverse PCB products with rapid delivery, meeting customers' needs for flexibility and speed. Its integrated supply chain from raw materials to full PCB production enhances efficiency and responsiveness. Emphasis on high-density, fine-line, and advanced PCB technologies, combined with strict quality control and environmental compliance, differentiates it in a competitive market.
